title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: Columbia University of New York. Thereafter, Dr. Kiran Patel began his practice in cardiology for over four decades and soon became a distinguished Cardiologist in Tampa, Florida. This experience motivated him to develop a Physician Practice Management Company which provided 14 practices, including family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, and cardiology to serve more than 8000 patients which helped him to form a multi-specialty network.
